Open an .h5ad or .h5mu file as a SCUBA object (Julia engine)

open_h5ad.Rd

Reads the schema and the cell metadata of an AnnData .h5ad file (or a MuData .h5mu file with open_h5mu()) and returns a scuba_source object that every SCUBA accessor accepts. Expression values and reductions are read from the file on demand by the Julia engine (SCUBA.jl), so no Python environment is needed. Requires scuba_engine() to be "julia".

Usage

open_h5ad(path)

open_h5mu(path)

Arguments

path

Path to an .h5ad (open_h5ad()) or .h5mu (open_h5mu()) file.

Value

An object of class scuba_source.

Details

Keys follow SCUBA.jl's rules. For .h5ad: the main matrix is modality "X" (features addressed bare or as X_<gene>, layers "X" and layers/*), each obsm data frame is a modality named after it (e.g. protein_CD117-AB), each numeric obsm array is a reduction (X_umap_1), and metadata columns may be given bare or as obs_<column>. For .h5mu: modalities are named after the MuData modalities (rna_GAPDH), reductions as <modality>_<key> (rna_X_umap_1, bare X_umap_1 when unique), metadata is the global obs plus each modality's obs as <modality>_<column>; cells absent from a modality are NaN / NA.

See also

update_object_metadata(), scuba_source_modalities()
